versions.changelog:
Version 1.0.2

- No code or documentation changes detected in this version.
- Functionality, usage, and supported features remain the same as the previous release.

- Added SKILL.md with full documentation of supported scales, detailed scoring rules, triggers, and output format.
- Expanded support to 9 major psychological scales, including PHQ-9, GAD-7, SAS, SDS, PSS-10, IES-R, TIPI, BIS/BAS, and PSQI.
- Updated scale handling for scoring, grading, and standardized explanations; emphasized rigorous reverse scoring and result templates.
- Improved user guidance, safety prompts, and crisis intervention protocol.
- Removed obsolete metadata files (skill-card.md, skill.md).
- Updated project documentation (README1.md) to reflect new features and usage.

- Initial release of APA experiment generator skill with version 2.0.0.
- Supports automatic generation of APA 7th edition Methods sections for psychology experiments across cognitive, social, developmental, and clinical paradigms.
- Includes structured templates for participants, design/materials, procedure (with trial timeline), and data analysis.
- Covers a wide range of experimental paradigms and variable designs; knowledge base provided in SKILL.md.
- Ensures academic style, ethical standards, and code support for OpenSesame/PsychoPy requests.
